mapper.select: INSERT INTO iam_refresh_token_families (identity_id, family_purpose, initial_credential_id, membership_id, tenant_id, context_version, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at, session_protocol) VALUES (#{row.identityId}, #{row.familyPurpose}, #{row.initialCredentialId}, #{row.membershipId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.contextVersion}, #{row.lastUsedAt}, #{row.absoluteExpiresAt}, #{row.revokedAt}, #{row.sessionProtocol}) RETURNING id, identity_id, family_purpose, initial_credential_id, membership_id, tenant_id, context_version, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_refresh_tokens (family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at) VALUES (#{row.familyId}, #{row.tokenDigest}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.consumedAt}) RETURNING id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at, rotation_key_digest, recovery_expires_at, recovered_at, successor_token_id, successor_access_jti

SELECT id, identity_id, family_purpose, initial_credential_id, membership_id, tenant_id, context_version, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at FROM iam_refresh_token_families WHERE id = #{familyId}

SELECT id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at, rotation_key_digest, recovery_expires_at, recovered_at, successor_token_id, successor_access_jti FROM iam_refresh_tokens WHERE token_digest = #{tokenDigest}

SELECT id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at, rotation_key_digest, recovery_expires_at, recovered_at, successor_token_id, successor_access_jti FROM iam_refresh_tokens WHERE token_digest = #{tokenDigest} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at, rotation_key_digest, recovery_expires_at, recovered_at, successor_token_id, successor_access_jti FROM iam_refresh_tokens WHERE id = #{tokenId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, identity_id, family_purpose, initial_credential_id, membership_id, tenant_id, context_version, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at FROM iam_refresh_token_families WHERE id = #{familyId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_refresh_token_families SET family_purpose = #{row.familyPurpose}, membership_id = #{row.membershipId}, tenant_id = #{row.tenantId}, context_version = #{row.contextVersion}, last_used_at = #{row.lastUsedAt}, absolute_expires_at = #{row.absoluteExpiresAt}, revoked_at = #{row.revokedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id}

UPDATE iam_refresh_tokens SET rotation_key_digest = #{rotationKeyDigest}, recovery_expires_at = #{recoveryExpiresAt}, successor_token_id = #{successorTokenId}, successor_access_jti = #{successorAccessJti} WHERE id = #{tokenId} AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND rotation_key_digest IS NULL
UPDATE iam_refresh_token_families SET revoked_at = GREATEST(#{revokedAt}, last_used_at) WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} AND family_purpose = 'INITIAL_PASSWORD_CHANGE' AND revoked_at IS NULL
